PHYSICAL RIGHT-SIDE DOOR LEAF is a scene fact and does NOT require screen-right placement.

Door Control controls door identity/material/open state/local Neil-side relation only. DO NOT inherit its camera, perspective, screen placement, centered-portal composition, daylight pattern, or floor reflection.

Camera = INTERIOR-SIDE / OBLIQUE / BROADSIDE-FIRST / DEPTH-SECOND. Do not create a centered portal establishing shot.
Crowd first motion read = LEFT→RIGHT lateral screen travel. Modest recession into deeper interior is secondary.
Most visible people are already to Neil's right. Use approximately 3–5 Generic Guests / partial bodies; do not force all ten.
Neil remains beside the physical right-side door leaf, near-frontal to camera, does not touch/close the door, and keeps head/eyes subtly toward frame-right watching the group tail already inside.
AST_IMG_000073 controls Neil identity only; exact body/head/gaze is controlled by shot authority.

AST_IMG_000011 controls Guang Yong identity only. If visible, Guang remains farther right with the group, body continues screen-right, and may retain only a small backward-awareness cue toward frame-left/Neil/open entrance. He remains tertiary.
Generic Guest REAR_3Q controls anonymous crowd identity continuity only, not 2×5 layout, number of guests, screen direction, blocking, queue formation, or camera geometry.
Generic Guest FRONT is not delivered as a direct visual input but remains the global identity conflict authority: FRONT WINS.
Warm low-key interior dominates. Exterior is only a small controlled cue. No broad cool floor reflection, no centered white/blue portal, no glossy floor emphasis.
No backpack, shoulder bag, handbag, luggage, travel bag, crossbody strap, or ambiguous bag-like foreground object.
No single-file queue, lineup, equal spacing, synchronized stride, front-facing ensemble, staged two-person frontal photo, or pasted-on/cutout character look.
Before any later generation, Work must revalidate Bundle V003 4/4 exact match. Any SHA / byte / Git blob / manifest verification failure means STOP / DO NOT GENERATE.
